future_check: Re-run the independent monitor after any generator or Racket authority change.
rationale: Replaced texture-driven sampling with relation-class schedule.; Reduced AXES to exact observable controls and fail-fast unknown keys.; Added structural self_check, strict curriculum predicate, semantic rivals/witnesses, and lesson identifiability.; Added RULE_HASH and regression tests.
summary: Split the 9-row input at its solid middle row into aligned 4-row top and bottom panels. For every aligned cell, output green (3) when either panel cell is nonzero; output black (0) only when both cells are black.

future_check: If palette coverage expands, add a uniquely observable profile name or remove the axis; never add unobservable raw-color overrides.
rationale: Finite named profiles keep every declared override exact and observable from the returned grid and ensure canonical anchors, shifted colors, and input-green absent/present cases. This deliberately trades exhaustive color-combination coverage for a small auditable curriculum.
summary: The generator uses four finite palette profiles rather than arbitrary color tuples.

future_check: Recipient v13 monitor should replay on generator SHA-256 7d197f84c9bd09d7f131aab534eaee3244698648c7cf007413e64c0b759efb30 and reject any hash mismatch or rival/probe mismatch.
rationale: The worker return is a candidate repair, not an independent safety verdict. Hidden never-train probes and exact source hashes protect against later schedule drift, authority drift, or accidental witness reuse.
summary: Replay sliding windows, hidden probes, and source hash before promotion.

future_check: After any schedule or profile edit, rerun all residue-class four-demo windows and require every named rival to be killed.
rationale: Every ordinary grid contains 00, 10, 01, and 11 aligned-cell relations, while every four-example window also crosses canonical/noncanonical widths and palettes. This directly teaches cellwise OR and kills top-only, bottom-only, XOR, AND, constant-fill, color-echo, fixed-width, and fixed-palette shortcuts.
summary: Use a four-slot occupancy-relation curriculum instead of texture families.

future_check: Require selected exact sync and execution parity whenever either canonical or task-local authority text changes.
rationale: The old target used an equivalent cell-at spelling, which produced source-authority divergence. The selected target now matches canonical text exactly; raw_code remains preserved only as archival history and was execution-parity checked on all five canonical pairs.
summary: Pin target_code exactly to canonical program_solution and retain raw_code as role-labeled archival executable text.

future_check: Reject any future texture/profile whose returned relation histogram omits 00, 10, 01, or 11.
rationale: The original generator treated checker/stripe/blob texture diversity as pedagogy. A checker override deterministically made the union solid because the two aligned checker panels shared the same phase, hiding both-empty structure and making the output constant green. Pattern variety therefore did not discriminate OR from constant fill or related Boolean rules.
summary: Texture variety alone is not adequate evidence for occupancy OR.
